Event 20 is inconsistent. It shows P053 (Right Center Midfield) under Team B, but P053 is a Team A player. In events 18 and 19, P053 received the ball and carried it for Team A. The pass in event 20 then reaches P503, also Team A, in event 21. So the team label on event 20 has been changed, which is a wrong_team corruption.
